questions.question: Five persons, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting at each corner of a pentagonal table, facing the centre. C is to the right of A and is second to the left of D. E is not between A and D. Who is sitting third to the left of E?
questions.solution:
Five persons, **A, B, C, D and E**, are sitting at each corner of a pentagonal table, facing the centre. 

1. C is to the right of A and is second to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddb03c1f530d3100a4444d997c2c9e48a871b4cfa6b098805e52114d914aff44.png] 

2. E is not between A and D. 

Clearly, E is sitting between D and C as it is the only position left for E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f85049c21f12f16dfe5fcaba20cb0e91a680b143cfa9938a551871fe097146dc.png] 

Now, the vacant position will be occupied by B, the only person left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d73db0aa551d5ec43c2d0cd1eebc6dd3ee062c0319302179a7676b82ebf868f.png] 

Clearly, B is sitting third to the left of E.

Hence, '**B**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

28, 14, 14, 21, 42, 105, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

28 × 0.5 = 14

14 × 1 = 14

14 × 1.5 = 21

21 × 2 = 42

42 × 2.5 = 105

105 × 3 = 315

Hence, '**315**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a class, there are 48 boys who are over 157 cm tall. If these constitute four-fifths of the boys and the total number of boys is three-fourths of the total number of students in the class, what is the number of girls in the class?
questions.solution:
Let the number of boys be x.

According to problem:

(4/5)x = 48

⇒ 4x = 48 × 5

⇒ 4x = 240

⇒ x = 240 ÷ 4

⇒ x = 60&l

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

D P _ X _ D _ N _ R _ P _ X R

options.text: N R P X D N
R N P X D N
N X P X D N
N R P X N D

questions.solution:
Given sequence: D P _ X _ D _ N _ R _ P _ X R

 
• N R P X D N → D P **N** X **R -** D **P** N **X** R - **D** P **N** X R
 
• R N P X D N → D P **R** X **N** - D P N X R - D P N X R
 
• N X P X D N → D P **N** X **X** - D **P** N **X** R - **D** P **N** X R
 
• N R P X N D → D P **N** X **R** - D **P** N **X** R - **N** P **D** X R

Hence, ‘**N R P X D N**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third numberin the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

78 ∶ 87 ∶∶ 43 ∶ ? ∶∶ 65 ∶ 56
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: When we interchange the positions of 1st number, we get second number.

 
• 78 ∶ 87 → When we interchange the positions of the digits in the number 78, we get 87.
 
• 65 ∶ 56 → When we interchange the positions of the digits in the number 65, we get 56.

Similarly,

 
• 43 ∶ ? → When we interchange the positions of the digits in the number 43, we get 34.

Hence, '**34**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Pen’ is related to ‘Ink’ in the same way as ‘Needle’ is related to ‘_______’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Pen’ is related to ‘Ink’ → Ink is required to use a pen. We can also say that pen and ink are complementary goods.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Needle’ is related to ‘_______’ → Needle is required to use a thread. Needle and thread are complementary goods.

Hence, '**Thread**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some dentists are surgeons.

II. All the surgeons are doctors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some dentists are doctors.

II. No surgeons are dentists.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbc2acd846b372303d6d74915f04023afd3f5726fc92f133c62d71df44f19d50.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some dentists are doctors. → **Follows** (As, Some dentists are surgeons and All the surgeons are doctors)

II. No surgeons are dentists. → Do not follow (As, Some dentists are surgeons)

Hence, '**Only conclusion I follows**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘a’ denotes ‘×’, ‘b’ denotes ‘÷’, ‘c’ denotes ‘–’, and ‘d’ denotes ‘+’, then what is the value of the following expression?

55a5b5c5d3
questions.solution:
**Letters**

 
 
 
a

 
 
 
b

 
 
 
c

 
 
 
d

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

Given expression: 55a5b5c5d3

After replacing the letters by their meaning, we get:

55 × __**5 ÷ **____**5**__ - 5 + 3

= __**55 **____**× 1**__ - 5 + 3

= __**55**__ - 5 __**+ 3**__

= 58 - 5

= 53

Hence, '**53**' is the correct answer.
